question: What is the meaning of volume in relation to physical properties, technical properties?
description: Volume is a physical property that measures the space occupied by a material or product. It is important for determining the amount of material needed for construction and its impact on the environment. Volume is also a technical property that affects the performance and functionality of a product, such as its capacity to hold or contain something. Volume is measured in cubic units, such as cubic meters or cubic centimeters. Volume is an essential property to consider when designing and manufacturing products and materials for sustainable construction.

3.1.3
Composition properties
Figure 5 shows the composition property facet. This block of ontology helps to optimise
the selection, processing, and assembly of the constituent parts and materials of a product
and facilitates their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product
to maximise the circularity.
Figure 5: Composition property facet of the MPO.
CompositionProperty has two subclasses, ConstituentPart and ConstituentMaterial. For
example, crossbeam has constituent materials carbon fibre, glass fibre, epoxy resin, alu-
minium, foam, and film adhesive that have mass, and a source and destination in a circular
economy.
